title: Fine Stone Concrete Pump: Aggregate Size and Pump Selection
seoTitle: Fine Stone Concrete Pump Aggregate Size Selection | Pinjin
description: Select a fine-stone concrete pump from published max aggregate and pipeline DN. Xingtai rows: B500S 5–16 mm, Electric 20 1–2 cm, Electric 15 1–3 cm, Electric 30 ≤3 cm plus fine-stone and agg13 distance pairs. ACI 304.2R aggregate-to-pipe limits are cited, not invented.

answerBlock.what: Fine-stone pump selection starts from the largest stone in the mix versus the published max-aggregate row, then from pipeline DN. Pinjin prints B500S-83D at 5–16 mm, Electric 20 at 1–2 cm, Electric 10 Series at 2 cm and below, Electric 15 at 1–3 cm, Electric 30 at ≤3 cm with a separate fine-stone distance pair. ACI 304.2R-17 limits angular coarse aggregate to one-third of the smallest pipeline inside diameter (rounded aggregate two-fifths). We do not invent a Pinjin formula.
answerBlock.who: Buyers who know max stone size and pipe DN and need to know which Xingtai trailer row can take that mix.
factors: Max stone versus the pump page aggregate cell
Pipe inside diameter on the same pump page (Electric 20: 80 mm; Electric 15: 100–125 mm)
Fine-stone H/V pair when the mix is named fine-stone (Electric 30 60/180; LP40 80/240; Electric 40 120/360)
ACI 304.2R aggregate-to-diameter check as industry reference, not a factory test sheet

faqs.question: What does Pinjin mean by fine-stone distance?
faqs.answer: A separate conveying-distance pair on some electric trailers (Electric 30, Low Pressure 40, Electric 40). It is not a substitute for the max aggregate cell. If your mix is 13 mm, read the agg13 row where it exists.

faqs.question: Can I use ACI’s one-third rule instead of the catalogue?
faqs.answer: Use both. The catalogue max aggregate is what we will quote against. ACI 304.2R-17 is industry guidance on aggregate versus pipeline diameter. We do not replace our table with a self-made formula.
